report.summary: All 26 tests (api and ui) error during the session-scoped base_url fixture, before any test body runs: the app process started by tests/conftest.py exits with code 1 before /health answers. Nothing in the app code or the tests points to a behavior bug, so the first step is to start the app by hand in the same environment (`DB_PATH=<tmp file> python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000`) to read its stderr and find the startup error, which the fixture discards.

causes.title: Uvicorn app process exits with code 1 during test session startup
causes.explanation: The base_url fixture launches `python -m uvicorn app.main:app` as a subprocess and polls it. The process exits with code 1 before it serves /health, so _wait_until_up raises immediately. Every test depends on this session fixture, so one startup failure fails all 26 tests. The app's own code looks sound on read-through: the module-level schema setup (app/main.py:68-69), the imports and the routes show no obvious error. The likely causes are environmental: a missing or mismatched dependency in the venv (uvicorn, fastapi, jinja2, python-multipart are listed in requirements.txt), a bad APP_DB_PATH or DB_PATH value, or a Python version mismatch. The fixture passes no stdout/stderr to the child (tests/conftest.py:58-62), so the reason is not in the report. The traceback points to a local Windows venv under C:\Users\IvanPosavec\Documents\qa-lab, while .github/workflows/tests.yml runs on ubuntu-latest, so this may be a local run rather than the CI run the report describes.
evidence: tests/conftest.py:35: raise RuntimeError(f"App exited early with code {proc.returncode}") (proc returncode: 1, args: ['C:\\Users\\IvanPosavec\\Documents\\qa-lab\\.ve...])
tests/conftest.py:58-62: subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--port", str(port), "--log-level", "warning"], cwd=ROOT, env=env) with no stdout/stderr capture
app/main.py:68-69: with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA) runs at import time against DB_PATH
All 26 failures have the identical message 'failed on setup with "RuntimeError: App exited early with code 1"'; no test body ran.
causes.suggested_fix: Reproduce the startup by hand in the same venv: `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` with DB_PATH set to a writable file, and read the traceback. Confirm that `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt` completed in that venv and that APP_DB_PATH, if set, points to a writable location. Then fix the environment (install deps, correct the path or Python version). As a debugging aid, change conftest.py so the child's stderr is captured, or included in the RuntimeError message, so the next failure says why the app exited. Re-run the suite after the fix; the product tests should then reveal any real behavior issues.
